name: cult4
description: Deterministic organizational foundation for autonomous businesses executed by OpenCode

scripts.test:live: npm run build && CULT4_LIVE_TEST=1 vitest run tests/live-opencode.test.ts --testTimeout=180000
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.ts' 'tests/**/*.ts' README.md RUNBOOK.md specs/ARCHITECTURE.md specs/FOUNDATION.md specs/SECURITY_MODEL.md specs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md specs/TRACEABILITY.md 'foundation/**/*.md' 'skills/**/*.md' 'tools/**/*.md' package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'src/**/*.ts' 'tests/**/*.ts' README.md RUNBOOK.md specs/ARCHITECTURE.md specs/FOUNDATION.md specs/SECURITY_MODEL.md specs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md specs/TRACEABILITY.md 'foundation/**/*.md' 'skills/**/*.md' 'tools/**/*.md' package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build
